implemented: In CppHandler::extract_calls_from_func, the bare `identifier` call arm now re-qualifies an unqualified call to a sibling member of the enclosing class. When the bare callee is not in defined_funcs but `<caller-class-prefix>::<callee>` is (caller-prefix = caller name minus its final ::component), the call site is emitted with the qualified sibling target and CallType::Intra. This lets the builder bind the same-file edge (out-of-line method defs register siblings only under their qualified name).
root_cause: tree-sitter-cpp registers an out-of-line method definition `void XMLUtil::ConvertUTF32ToUTF8(){}` only under its qualified name in collect_definitions; the bare `ConvertUTF32ToUTF8` is never inserted into defined_funcs. A bare same-class call `ConvertUTF32ToUTF8(...)` inside out-of-line `XMLUtil::GetCharacterRef` therefore fell to CallType::Direct with a bare target. The builder's resolve_intra path can only re-derive the class via enclosing_class_for_call, which splits the caller on '.' (not '::') and reads FuncDef.class_name=None for out-of-line defs, so it returned None and the bare Direct target matched no node -> edge dropped -> false dead-code + degenerate impact context.
spike_decision: SPIKE-THEN-PATCH. Decision recorded before coding: derive the enclosing class scope from the caller's already-qualified name (strip the final `::component`) rather than from FuncDef.class_name (which is None for out-of-line defs) or enclosing_class_for_call (which splits on '.'). Re-qualify only when the bare name is NOT already a defined func AND `<prefix>::<bare>` IS — this leaves inline members (bare name already registered, first arm) and free functions (no '::' in caller) untouched, and emits the qualified sibling target with CallType::Intra so the existing builder resolve_intra/func_index path resolves it. Chosen over (a) marking bare+Intra (fails: enclosing_class_for_call can't recover the class for `::`-qualified callers) and (b) registering bare aliases for out-of-line defs in collect_definitions (would collide across classes and pollute Direct lookups).
generalization_test: MANDATORY generalization satisfied. cpp is the sole language in the symptom class. Added 3 lib tests in cpp.rs cross_scope_tests: (1) test_unqualified_sibling_call_from_out_of_line_method (out-of-line, no namespace) asserts target XMLUtil::ConvertUTF32ToUTF8 + Intra; (2) test_unqualified_sibling_call_in_namespace_out_of_line (out-of-line nested in `namespace`) — same assertion, covers the ns::Class::sibling registration variant; (3) test_unqualified_external_call_from_free_function_unchanged regression guard ensures a free-function bare call stays Direct/bare (no fabricated sibling edges). Existing test_extract_calls_class_method (inline sibling, bare target) still passes. Cross-repo: cpp-fmt now yields 107 same-class sibling edges with no crash.
